notes.title: The Long Awaited Update is Finally Coming!
notes.content:
Tomorrow, the final major update to Hi-Score Boi will finally be released! There's 3 new levels, costume updates, new visuals and 4 new achievements to unlock!

Thank you everyone for your patience. And of course this isn't the end of Hi-Score Boi's journey. So be on the look out for smaller updates down the line and some new games in the future ;)

notes.title: Nearing the finish line!
notes.content:
So much has happened since the last update! While working on the game's new content, a best friend was lost that was one of the biggest supporters of this project. So extra care has been taken to make sure the final update for this game is something he would be proud of. While most of the major work is out of the way, a few more adjustments need to be made before the update out. Have fun and stay safe over the holiday season! Here's a few progress screenshots!

notes.title: Another update and a true challenge!
notes.content:
I’ve been posting most of the update over on [url=https://88domo.itch.io/hi-score-boi/devlog]itch.io[/url] if you want to go back and look at older posts. But since this version is updated now, I’ll post things here. I’ve been working on what may be the last update for this game so I can 100% focus on the next few projects. The plan of this next update is to add 3 more levels and 4 more achievements bringing the total to 70. Three of those achievements will be hard :^) 

Besides the levels and the achievements, I want to tweak the UI a bit more. Here’s a little preview!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9E2AJHg.png[/img]

Also! The sale will last til the game’s one year anniversary!
